## Names

<a id="get_colour_slot"></a>
### [`get_colour_slot`](../../../../src/graphics/colour_slots.asm#L6) `$1525`

*routine*

Gives in A the pixel value (0-3) for current_colour in the cell of pixel_ptr. 0 = the background colour. Loads the cell colours (load_cell_colours), then continues at colour_slot_in_cell. Also an entry of the JMP table at $0900.

- **Called from:** [`plot_brush`](plot_brush.md#plot_brush) [`$1804`](../../../../src/graphics/plot_brush.asm#L59), [`plot_dither_pixel`](brush_plot.md#plot_dither_pixel) [`$185A`](../../../../src/graphics/brush_plot.asm#L55), [`copy_tool`](../tools/copy.md#copy_tool) [`$3576`](../../../../src/tools/copy.asm#L194)
- **Jumped to from:** [`jt_sample_pad`](../init/entry.md#jt_sample_pad) [`$0912`](../../../../src/init/entry.asm#L17)
- **Entry of:** [`entry_jump_table`](../../tables.md#entry_jump_table)
- **Calls:** [`load_cell_colours`](colour_slots.md#load_cell_colours)
- **Reads:** [`current_colour`](../../memory-map.md#current_colour), [`background_colour`](../../memory-map.md#background_colour)

<a id="colour_slot_in_cell"></a>
### [`colour_slot_in_cell`](../../../../src/graphics/colour_slots.asm#L16) `$1531`

*routine*

Gives in A the pixel value (1-3) of the cell colour (cell_colour_1-3) that is current_colour. When no cell colour is current_colour, counts the pixels of each value in the 8 bytes of the cell. The value with the fewest pixels (the higher value when equal) gets current_colour in the screen or colour RAM (write_cell_colours), and A gives this value.

- **Called from:** [`fill_set_pixel`](../tools/fill_3833.md#fill_set_pixel) [`$39A9`](../../../../src/tools/fill_3833.asm#L246)
- **Calls:** [`write_cell_colours`](colour_slots.md#write_cell_colours)
- **Reads:** [`current_colour`](../../memory-map.md#current_colour), [`cell_colour_1`](../../memory-map.md#cell_colour_1), [`cell_colour_2`](../../memory-map.md#cell_colour_2), [`cell_colour_3`](../../memory-map.md#cell_colour_3), [`pixel_ptr`](../../memory-map.md#pixel_ptr), [`pixel_ptr+1`](../../memory-map.md#pixel_ptr), [`temp_word`](../../memory-map.md#temp_word), [`count_pixels_1`](../../memory-map.md#count_pixels_1), [`count_pixels_2`](../../memory-map.md#count_pixels_2), [`count_pixels_3`](../../memory-map.md#count_pixels_3)
- **Writes:** [`count_pixels_1`](../../memory-map.md#count_pixels_1), [`count_pixels_2`](../../memory-map.md#count_pixels_2), [`count_pixels_3`](../../memory-map.md#count_pixels_3), [`temp_word`](../../memory-map.md#temp_word), [`temp_word_hi`](../../memory-map.md#temp_word_hi), [`cell_colour_3`](../../memory-map.md#cell_colour_3), [`cell_colour_1`](../../memory-map.md#cell_colour_1), [`cell_colour_2`](../../memory-map.md#cell_colour_2)

<a id="load_cell_colours"></a>
### [`load_cell_colours`](../../../../src/graphics/colour_slots.asm#L101) `$15B7`

*routine*

Sets cell_screen_ptr and cell_colour_ptr for the cell of the selected pixel (bitmap_row_base, pixel_x) and reads the cell colours into cell_colour_1-3 (read_cell_colours). Does nothing when the cell is the cell of the last load (cached_cell_ptr).

- **Called from:** [`get_colour_slot`](colour_slots.md#get_colour_slot) [`$152E`](../../../../src/graphics/colour_slots.asm#L14), [`tool_xcolor`](../tools/xcolor_tool.md#tool_xcolor) [`$169F`](../../../../src/tools/xcolor_tool.asm#L32), [`zoom_draw_pixel`](../zoom/zoom_view.md#zoom_draw_pixel) [`$31D2`](../../../../src/zoom/zoom_view.asm#L83), [`flood_fill`](../tools/fill.md#flood_fill) [`$3720`](../../../../src/tools/fill.asm#L20), [`fill_paint_first`](../tools/fill_3833.md#fill_paint_first) [`$3971`](../../../../src/tools/fill_3833.asm#L213), [`fill_check_pixel`](../tools/fill_3833.md#fill_check_pixel) [`$3A21`](../../../../src/tools/fill_3833.asm#L321)

<a id="read_cell_colours"></a>
### [`read_cell_colours`](../../../../src/graphics/colour_slots.asm#L141) `$15F9`

*routine*

Reads the colours of the cell at cell_screen_ptr and cell_colour_ptr: cell_colour_1 = high nybble of the screen byte, cell_colour_2 = low nybble, cell_colour_3 = colour RAM. Then stores pixel_ptr AND $f8 in cached_cell_ptr.

- **Called from:** [`clear_colour_pixels`](../tools/xcolor_tool.md#clear_colour_pixels) [`$173A`](../../../../src/tools/xcolor_tool.asm#L125)
- **Reads:** [`cell_screen_ptr`](../../memory-map.md#cell_screen_ptr), [`cell_colour_ptr`](../../memory-map.md#cell_colour_ptr), [`pixel_ptr`](../../memory-map.md#pixel_ptr), [`pixel_ptr+1`](../../memory-map.md#pixel_ptr)
- **Writes:** [`cell_colour_2`](../../memory-map.md#cell_colour_2), [`cell_colour_1`](../../memory-map.md#cell_colour_1), [`cell_colour_3`](../../memory-map.md#cell_colour_3), [`cell_cache_addr`](../../memory-map.md#cell_cache_addr), [`cell_cache_addr+1`](../../memory-map.md#cell_cache_addr)

<a id="write_cell_colours"></a>
### [`write_cell_colours`](../../../../src/graphics/colour_slots.asm#L162) `$161C`

*routine*

Writes cell_colour_1 (high nybble) and cell_colour_2 (low nybble) to the screen byte at cell_screen_ptr, and cell_colour_3 to the colour RAM at cell_colour_ptr.

- **Called from:** [`colour_slot_in_cell`](colour_slots.md#colour_slot_in_cell) [`$1596`](../../../../src/graphics/colour_slots.asm#L81), [`colour_slot_in_cell`](colour_slots.md#colour_slot_in_cell) [`$15A7`](../../../../src/graphics/colour_slots.asm#L91), [`colour_slot_in_cell`](colour_slots.md#colour_slot_in_cell) [`$15B1`](../../../../src/graphics/colour_slots.asm#L97)
